text_block_list.text:
—A deafening roar from the crowd.
—Cheers echoing across the stands.

That was truly something meant
just for Taiki Shuttle!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: That was awesome, Taiki Shuttle--!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the greatest race ever!!
It was really... really
so exciting!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"YEEEEES!!
Thank you for the cheering!!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, did you see that!?
I am number one! The Mile King!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
With the legs... with these legs that you were
the first to believe in... with these LEGS...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: *Sniff*...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no, no!
It's a waste of time to cry!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Your happy smile,
and everyone else's happy smile too.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: There is NO WAY I can miss this!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Good work, Taiki.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Suzuka, good work out there to you too!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...It's frustrating.
I really thought I threw everything, absolutely everything into it, but...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't able to keep up...
with your speed...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you, Suzuka.
...My best friend.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Taiki—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...You know,
I haven't given up, of course."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"I will definitely go beyond you,
beyond the realm of speed itself."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
So... let's run together again.
...It's a promise.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Suzuka...!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course!!
My frieeeend!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"W-Wait... No hugging, seriously, no hugging.
When you do that, it can actually hurt pretty bad sometimes..."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh!? Why is that~~~!!

"—Taiki Shuttle has delivered
flawless, 100-point results every step of the way."
Conquering the Yasuda Kinen, the Sprinters Stakes, and the Mile Championship.

"On top of that, defeating the strongest Umamusume
of our era, Silence Suzuka—"

"There is no longer any doubt
about Taiki Shuttle's skill and star power!"
choice_data_list: Let's become Uma Musume of the Year, no matter what!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yeeees!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Keep your eyes on me, Trainer!!
Watch as I catch my dream!!
